beats: Every feature demo looked the same: dark, dense, built for people who already read code.
If you weren't technical, the videos were noise — like reading sheet music instead of hearing the song.
I built a second visual language in Remotion — bright, plain-English panels anyone can follow.
Then I gave one feature a voice: a full narrated walkthrough instead of a silent loop.
That walkthrough runs fifty-four seconds — the first fully narrated demo this project has ever shipped.
